segments.he: רבינו ז"ל אמר שהוא אוהב שענינו יבא על לבות של ליטוואקיס כי יש להם לב חזק והם עקשנים גדולים וזה מעלה גדולה בעבודת השם "זיין זאך שאל איבער גיין אוף ליטוושי הערצער".
segments.en: In the days of Moharan'as, there was one of our fellowship who was an itinerant trader, traveling to the market fair for his livelihood. After toiling all day and returning home at night, his wife would greet him with contempt and insults as was her nature — and the home would be in disorder. Nor would there be food prepared as he wished: the floor of the entrance would be muddy and unswept, the room disordered and no food prepared — for she was a shlimazlnitze [an unfortunate, incompetent woman]. He was full of suffering from this — for he thought that at least after the toil and exhaustion of the entire day he would at least find rest at home at night — and in the end he found such "rest." He told his distress before Moharan'as — that he barely had his life from this.
